title: 🔥 YOU CALL YOURSELF A CHRISTIAN, BUT STILL FOLLOW MAN-MADE TRADITIONS? READ THIS! 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 YOU CALL YOURSELF A CHRISTIAN, BUT STILL FOLLOW MAN-MADE TRADITIONS? READ THIS! 🔥
📖 Mark 7:8 – "You have let go of the commands of God and are holding on to human traditions."

❓ QUESTION FROM A READER:
"Brother John, many people say they are Christians, but they continue to follow traditions that are not in the Bible. Some even prioritize traditions over God’s Word. Is this right? What does the Bible say about it?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people claim to follow Jesus, but their actions show otherwise. Instead of obeying God’s Word, they cling to man-made traditions that have no biblical foundation. Some even say, "This is how we’ve always done it," as if tradition can override the truth!
🚨 But here’s the question: Are these traditions leading people to Christ, or are they leading them AWAY from God’s truth?
Let’s expose the lies and stand on BIBLICAL TRUTH!

🔥 1. TRUE CHRISTIANITY VS. MAN-MADE TRADITIONS
📖 Matthew 15:3 – "Jesus replied, ‘And why do you break the command of God for the sake of your tradition?’"
🔥 A true Christian follows Jesus, NOT religious traditions.

✔️ Christianity is about a relationship with God, not rituals.
✔️ Jesus NEVER told us to follow human traditions—He told us to follow HIM.
✔️ Man-made traditions often lead people away from God’s truth!
🚨 The Pharisees in Jesus’ time were religious, but they rejected Him because they valued traditions more than truth. Many today are doing the same!
💡 Are you following Jesus, or just following what people have told you?

🔥 2. COMMON MAN-MADE TRADITIONS THAT MANY CHRISTIANS FOLLOW (BUT AREN’T BIBLICAL!)
📖 Colossians 2:8 – "See to it that no one takes you captive through hollow and deceptive philosophy, which depends on human tradition rather than on Christ."
🔥 Many people follow traditions that are NOT in the Bible! Let’s expose them!

❌ TRADITION: "Praying to saints and Mary as mediators."
✔️ BIBLICAL TRUTH: Jesus is the ONLY mediator between God and man (1 Timothy 2:5).

❌ TRADITION: "Repeating memorized prayers over and over (rosary, novenas, etc.)."
✔️ BIBLICAL TRUTH: Jesus warned against repetitive prayers (Matthew 6:7).

❌ TRADITION: "Celebrating religious festivals that are not found in Scripture."
✔️ BIBLICAL TRUTH: God never commanded Christians to celebrate these man-made events (Mark 7:13).

❌ TRADITION: "Believing that good works or church rituals can save you."
✔️ BIBLICAL TRUTH: Salvation is by grace through faith alone (Ephesians 2:8-9).

❌ TRADITION: "Bowing before statues, relics, or religious images."
✔️ BIBLICAL TRUTH: This is IDOLATRY, and God strictly forbids it! (Exodus 20:4-5).
🚨 MANY PEOPLE TODAY FOLLOW RELIGION, NOT JESUS!
💡 Are you following Christ or just doing what has been passed down to you?

🔥 3. JESUS WARNED US ABOUT TRADITIONS THAT REPLACE GOD'S COMMANDS!
📖 Mark 7:9 – "You have a fine way of setting aside the commands of God in order to observe your own traditions!"
🔥 Jesus constantly rebuked religious leaders who prioritized human traditions over God's truth!

✔️ The Pharisees were obsessed with rituals, but their hearts were far from God.
✔️ Many today claim to love Jesus but refuse to let go of religious traditions.
✔️ True faith is not about customs—it’s about knowing and obeying God's Word!
🚨 Religion without true obedience to Christ is EMPTY!
💡 Ask yourself: Do I follow traditions that contradict the Bible? If yes, it's time to choose between TRUTH and TRADITION!

🔥 4. THE DANGER OF FOLLOWING MAN-MADE TRADITIONS
📖 Matthew 7:21-23 – "Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only the one who does the will of My Father."
🔥 Many THINK they are Christians, but they are actually following a FALSE, TRADITION-BASED Christianity!

❌ They trust in rituals instead of in Christ.
❌ They follow what their church says instead of what the Bible says.
❌ They ignore biblical warnings and hold onto tradition out of fear or pride.
🚨 Jesus made it clear: Only those who obey GOD'S WORD will be saved!
💡 What matters is not how religious you are, but whether you are following Jesus in spirit and truth!

🔥 5. REAL-LIFE TESTIMONY – FREED FROM TRADITIONS!
A woman grew up in a church that taught her to pray to saints, bow before statues, and perform religious rituals. She believed these traditions were necessary for salvation.
🔥 One day, she read Exodus 20:4-5 and realized that the Bible strictly forbids idolatry!
🚨 She repented, threw away her religious images, and started worshiping Jesus alone. Now, she has a real, personal relationship with God—not just empty traditions.
💡 THIS is what true Christianity is—following CHRIST, not man-made customs!

🔥 FINAL WARNING: TRADITION WILL NOT SAVE YOU!
📖 Matthew 15:8-9 – "These people honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me. They worship Me in vain; their teachings are merely human rules."
🚨 Many will stand before Jesus on Judgment Day thinking they were saved, only to hear, "I NEVER KNEW YOU!"

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
❌ Continue following man-made traditions that contradict the Bible?
✔️ Surrender to Jesus, obey His Word, and reject false teachings?
🚨 CHOOSE NOW—BECAUSE YOUR ETERNITY DEPENDS ON IT!

🙏 PRAYER FOR DELIVERANCE FROM RELIGIOUS TRADITIONS
"Heavenly Father, open my eyes to Your truth. If I have followed traditions that are not from You, I repent. Teach me to worship You in spirit and truth. Help me to obey Your Word alone and not the rules of men. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
